children: DCC Energy said it has agreed to sell Nexora to funds owned and advised by One Equity Partners in a deal that values the technology division at $725 million.
DCC Energy itself agreed to be sold to Energy Capital Partners and KKR & Co. in July this year, in a deal that valued it at around 5.75 billion pounds ($7.61 billion).

Under this original deal, DCC shareholders would get 6,525 pence a share in cash and the proposed final dividend of 147.22 pence a DCC share as previously announced. They would also get up to 125 pence a share if the company sold Nexora. The amount they would receive was contingent on the sale price of the division.
DCC Energy said Friday that it expects proceeds of $701 million from the sale of Nexora, which means DCC shareholders are expected to receive an extra 42 pence a share.
It said it expects the sale to complete on or after March 1.
